verdict.line: You lose extended auto-trades and all-ins into an up Counter Strike (E), and you win short burst trades off an E-Q stun chain when his E is down.

brief.thesis: Jax's Counter Strike (E) dodges incoming basic attacks and then stuns everyone around him, which directly punishes Irelia's stack-and-auto trade pattern and her Q (Bladesurge) engage if she leads with autos into it. That single cooldown is why Jax holds both the lane and solo-kill edge here even though the matchup reads as structurally even — Irelia's 44.2% win rate over 52 games comes from mistiming trades around it, not from a hard power deficit.

theirWindow.when: When his Counter Strike (E) is up
theirWindow.what: Do not lead with autos or stand in melee range to stack your passive — he dodges the attacks and stuns you on the counter. If he also has Empower (W) ready (7/6/5/4/3s cooldown), expect a glowing empowered auto or Leap Strike (Q, range 700) on top of it; hold W (Defiant Dance) to charge into that hit since it reduces physical damage taken while charging.

yourWindow.when: When his Counter Strike (E) is down
yourWindow.what: This is your window to commit. From level 3 on, open with E (Flawless Duet, range 850) to stun and Mark him, Q (Bladesurge) in off the Mark for the dash-reset, then auto freely while Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed — there's no Counter Strike waiting to punish the autos.

start.why: 40.7% win rate over 54 games and the overwhelming pick (88.5%) — the extra sustain matters because you can't win extended auto-trades into Counter Strike without it.

boots.why: 39.2% win rate, 89.5% pick — Jax's whole kit (Relentless Assault stacks, Empowered autos) is basic-attack damage, so flat physical reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: Sustain and on-hit damage to survive the early lane deficit and keep trading even when you can't land a clean Q reset.

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.8% win rate on this page, highest pick rate (38.3%) — the stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the kind of grinding, multi-hit trades you're forced into against Counter Strike.

summoners.why: 40.9% win rate and by far the most-picked combo (73.3%) — Ignite punishes his sustain-light early trades and Flash lets you dodge or follow up on Leap Strike (Q) engages.

playing.title: Track Counter Strike, not his health
playing.detail: His Counter Strike (E) is 18/16/14/12/10s. Never lead a trade with autos while it's up — wait it out or force it to whiff on a minion first.

playing.title: Respect the Empower telegraph
playing.detail: Empower (W, 7/6/5/4/3s cooldown) lights up his next attack or Leap Strike. Hold W (Defiant Dance) charge for that hit — it reduces physical damage taken while charging.

playing.title: Chain E into Q from level 3
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anyone caught between the blades; Q (Bladesurge) refreshes instantly off a Marked target, letting you reset the dash and keep stacking your passive mid-combo.

playing.title: Don't out-range his engage with Q alone
playing.detail: Leap Strike (Q) is range 700 versus your Bladesurge's 600 — he can initiate off a minion or ward from further out than you can answer with Q.

playing.title: Use R to open, not finish
playing.detail: Vanguard's Edge (R) Marks on hit, so firing it as an opener sets up a free Q reset into the fight rather than saving it purely as a kill tool.

playing.title: Avoid standing auto-trades past level 7
playing.detail: Relentless Assault stacks his attack speed passively with every third hit dealing bonus damage — extended stand-and-swing fights favor him more as the game goes on, so disengage and reset instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown/range values are from the game files; the tactical reading of how to use them is our own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Try to engage whenever Jax’s Counter Strike (E) is on cooldown. Absorb Jax’s (W) damage with a well-timed [W], while waiting for an opportunity to strike back by keeping your [P] stacks up.
